bullets: Built the company's on-premise infrastructure from scratch on two repurposed desktops — a Proxmox VE + PBS cluster running 7+ virtualized services (NAS, reverse proxy, DNS, VPN, monitoring) with automated nightly backups and near-99% uptime.
Redesigned the factory network for ~230 staff and 60+ devices: dual-WAN load-balancing + failover, a structured /24 IP plan, and WireGuard / Tailscale remote access.

Established the factory's information security program under the automotive AISC framework (24 domains, 150+ documents) with ISO/IEC 27001 as an internal baseline, authored IATF 16949 / ISO 9001 quality procedures, and delivered company-wide cybersecurity awareness training.
Automated IT operations with n8n: backup and infrastructure health monitoring, AI-powered email triage, and monthly compliance reports filed into QMS documents after one-click human approval.

Cut recurring IT costs 45,200฿/year by self-hosting open-source replacements (OpenMediaVault, Wazuh + Defender), and automated daily ops for 50 workstations with PowerShell + RMM into centralized dashboards.

caseStudies.label: CASE STUDIES
caseStudies.note: Diagrams are redrawn and sanitized — no real addresses, credentials, or internal identifiers.

studies.title: On-Premise Virtualization Cluster
studies.body: The company had no servers, no budget, and one IT person. Two repurposed desktops became a Proxmox VE + PBS cluster running 7+ virtualized services — NAS, reverse proxy, DNS filtering, VPN, automation, and the app server hosting the ERP and Rotjana — with automated nightly backups and near-99% uptime.
studies.alt: Diagram of the on-premise virtualization cluster

studies.title: Factory Network Redesign
studies.body: A flat network on a single line served 230 people — one outage stopped everything. The redesign brought dual-WAN load balancing with automatic failover, a structured /24 plan separating office, production, and server zones, and WireGuard / Tailscale tunnels for remote access.
studies.alt: Diagram of the redesigned factory network

studies.title: Security & AI Automation Program
studies.body: Compliance and monitoring don't scale to a one-person team by hand. A 24-domain security framework under the automotive AISC standard (ISO/IEC 27001 as internal baseline), Wazuh + Defender on every endpoint, and n8n workflows that watch backups and infrastructure, triage email with Claude, and file monthly compliance reports into QMS registers — a human approves every write.
studies.alt: Diagram of the security and AI automation pipeline

skills.name: Proxmox
skills.desc: Open-source virtualization platform managing a Proxmox VE + PBS cluster — 7+ services including NAS, reverse proxy, DNS, VPN, and monitoring on bare-metal hardware.

skills.name: Docker
skills.desc: Containerizes all self-hosted services for consistent, isolated deployments across the Proxmox cluster and development environments.

skills.name: Linux
skills.desc: Server OS for every on-premise service — Ubuntu Server, systemd administration, CLI scripting, and service management.

skills.name: Cloudflare
skills.desc: DNS, CDN, and Zero Trust tunnels — exposes self-hosted services securely to the internet without opening inbound ports.

skills.name: Claude API
skills.desc: Agentic tool use and vision — powers Rotjana, a Discord agent that reads and safely updates QMS documents in plain Thai, plus AI email triage in automation workflows.

skills.name: n8n
skills.desc: Self-hosted workflow automation — backup monitoring, infrastructure health checks, and monthly compliance reports with human-in-the-loop approval.

skills.name: Node.js
skills.desc: JavaScript runtime behind the backend — powers the Rotjana AI agent (Express · discord.js) and the API layers of the ERP and internal tools.

skills.name: Next.js
skills.desc: React framework with server-side rendering and file-based routing — used for ERP operator interfaces and internal dashboards.

skills.name: TypeScript
skills.desc: Primary language for all web and API projects — type-safe, scales cleanly to larger codebases, and eliminates a whole class of runtime errors.

skills.name: PostgreSQL
skills.desc: Primary relational database for ERP data — production records, BOM, inventory — reliable under concurrent factory floor usage.

skills.name: Git
skills.desc: Version control for all projects — every change tracked, safe rollbacks, and a clean history for solo and collaborative work.

skills.name: Figma
skills.desc: UI design and wireframing before implementation — used to prototype ERP operator screens and management interfaces.
